picks.why: A local-model release pushes deployment claims toward laptops, with vendor measurements that still need independent task testing.
An archival project pairs AI reconstruction with human review and formal checking, making errors and repairs part of the story.
Integer-only inference targets repeatable outputs across hardware and batching, without confusing determinism with correctness.
Self-hosted managed agents expand operational control without implying that all inference or risk stays local.
A usage proxy makes spend visible while documenting budget overshoot, logging privacy and availability tradeoffs.
